skill.summary: 提供SEO优化的可落地指南与SOP。在开展SEO优化相关工作时调用。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release summarizing actionable SEO optimization strategies and SOPs:

- Provides practical guidelines for technical SEO, content strategy, off-site optimization, and compliance.
- Covers natural search traffic growth across major engines (Baidu, 360, Sogou, Google).
- Includes detailed technical recommendations: title & description lengths, semantic structure, canonical URLs, mobile adaptation, image optimization, and more.
- Outlines content clustering, FAQ/schema strategies, and external link building best practices.
- Emphasizes data monitoring and compliance with advertising laws.
- Supplies implementation checklists and templates to aid SEO operations.
